parts.name: enclosure-front-bottom
parts.model_overhangs_review: Four actual support bodies and four labeled interfaces: two downward-open handhold lifting ceilings and two fully exposed Z-seam catch undersides. The square lifting/bearing surfaces are retained. No support reaches the condenser seat, core corner stops or printed collet-plate feet in this slice. Clean the loose shell before any equipment or top shell is fitted; physical effort remains unmeasured.

trees.contact_region: West handhold lifting-ceiling tree, bed rooted, contacting its one labeled underside island.
trees.removal_lane: Detach from the lifting ceiling and pull down through the same fully downward-open handhold/finger aperture. Both end walls stop the pocket along Y, while its complete bottom remains open; no installed hardware is present.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: −Z through the open bottom of the handhold.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The broad flat handhold ceiling is the lifting surface and retains its full roof and backing stock.

trees.contact_region: West Z-seam catch ribbon, model rooted in the exposed groove and reaching the one catch-underside interface.
trees.removal_lane: Peel the narrow ribbon from the catch underside toward the exterior flank. The entire groove is exposed above the lower shell mouth, with no top shell or hardware over it; the run has no returning pocket branch.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: −X outboard through the exposed west groove.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: The catch underside bears against the top shell foot along the complete rail; retain its flat square working face.
